t: New Twilight Zone: The Junction
d: A modern-day miner has an argument with his wife and then goes off to work in the local mine. A collapse traps him, but he finds another survivor - a miner who claims to be from 1912.

t: New Twilight Zone: Extra Innings
d: Ex-baseball player Ed Hamler, lame from an injury and forced to retire early is given a 1909 baseball card of a player that looks exactly like him. The card is magical in that he becomes drawn into it and lives out the life of the player in the past.

t: New Twilight Zone: The Crossing
d: A stressed-out priest repeatedly encounters a station wagon containing a young girl. The car keeps crashing and bursting into flames.

t: New Twilight Zone: The Call
d: A lonely man accidentally phones the wrong number and finds an intriguing female to whom he grows attached. When she refuses to meet him, he investigates and finds the phone in a museum next to the statue of a woman.

t: The Twilight Zone: Little Girl Lost
d: Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Fugitive
d: Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.

t: The Twilight Zone: Person or Persons Unknown
d: David Gurney wakes up to find that no one - his wife, his co-workers, his best friend, not even his own mother knows him.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Little People
d: An astronaut declares himself a god when his ship lands on a planet populated by people smaller than ants.

t: The Twilight Zone: Four O'Clock
d: Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.

t: The Twilight Zone: Hocus-Pocus and Frisby
d: A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Trade-Ins
d: An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Gift
d: An alien who crash-lands into a remote mountain village stirs up the villagers' fears and animosity, but he befriends a little boy and gives him a mysterious present.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Dummy
d: A ventriloquist is convinced that his dummy, Willie, is alive and evil. He makes plans for a new act with a new dummy: plans that Willie doesn't support!

t: The Twilight Zone: Young Man's Fancy
d: When a newlywed couple briefly returns to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.

t: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
d: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

t: The Twilight Zone: In Praise Of Pip
d: An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.

t: The Twilight Zone: Steel
d: Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.

t: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 20,000 Feet
d: Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.

t: The Twilight Zone: A Kind of a Stopwatch
d: Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."

t: The Twilight Zone: The Last Night of a Jockey
st: The Last Night of a Jockey
d: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.

t: The Twilight Zone: Living Doll
d: Erich is displeased when his wife buys an expensive doll for his step-daughter. He becomes even more displeased when the doll tells him it doesn't like him!

t: The Twilight Zone: The Old Man in the Cave
st: The Old Man in the Cave
d: A mysterious guardian helps a tiny community survive after the Bomb destroys much of the Earth.

t: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
d: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

t: The Twilight Zone: Probe 7, Over and Out
d: The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.

t: The Twilight Zone: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
st: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
d: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.

t: The Twilight Zone: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain
st: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain
d: Trying to keep up with his younger wife, Harmon convinces his brother to inject him with an experimental youth serum.

t: The Twilight Zone: Ninety Years Without Slumbering
d: An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.

t: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
d: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

t: The Twilight Zone: You Drive
d: Driving home one rainy evening, Oliver Pope accidentally hits a boy on a bicycle. Pope flees the scene, determined to hide his guilt, but his car has other ideas.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Long Morrow
d: Before leaving on his mission, an astronaut meets a woman. They fall in love...

t: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
d: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

t: Pet Sematary
d: En flytning er for de fleste familier en ny begyndelse. Men for familien Creeds kunne det være begyndelsen til enden. For de er netop flyttet ind ved siden af et sted bygget af børn med knuste drømme, dyrekirkegården.
